description: The seven Pi built-in tools Agenta always activates on every Pi run. Neither language owns this list: the Python PI_BUILTIN_TOOL_NAMES (agenta/sdk/agents/pi_builtins.py) and the TypeScript PI_BUILTIN_TOOL_IDENTITY (services/runner/src/permission-plan.ts) are two implementations of this one pinned contract. ruleName is the canonical name a permission rule and a gate report use; readOnly decides which built-ins auto-run under the allow_reads policy.
